items.title: US-Iran talks postponed as Vance pulls out of Switzerland trip
items.description: The talks were expected to focus on implementing the deal to end the war signed earlier this week.

items.title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes kill 18 as Israel says four soldiers killed by Hezbollah
items.description: It comes a day after the US and Iran signed a deal to end their conflict, including fighting in Lebanon.

items.title: What Iran and US get from deal and why both could struggle to keep it
items.description: BBC analysts assess the claims by both Washington and Tehran to have won a victory with the deal to end their war.

items.title: Do it at home too, women tell Japanese fans who cleaned World Cup stadium
items.description: Some see a double standard: Japanese men who clean in public while their wives do all the housework.

items.title: Zimbabwe MPs pass bill to extend president's time in power
items.description: The proposal would extend Emmerson Mnangagwa's term by two years and scrap direct presidential elections.

items.title: Moscow residents complain of black rain after largest Ukrainian attack hits oil refinery
items.description: A refinery and a shopping centre burned after almost 200 Ukrainian drones were launched towards an area to the south-east of the Russian capital.

items.title: Thirty-five killed as gunmen attack Niger's biggest airport
items.description: Niger has been fighting a militant Islamist insurgency for a decade and in January suspected jihadists attacked the same airport.

items.title: Asia's richest man Ambani announces what could be India's biggest share sale
items.description: India's largest telecom operator is expected to raise around $4bn (£3.02bn), according to media reports.

items.title: In Trump's shadow, Vance becomes face of Iran deal
items.description: His fierce defence of the Iran plan amid mounting criticism comes as speculation intensifies about a possible 2028 presidential run.

items.title: Bowen: US-Iran deal raises inescapable question of what the war was for
items.description: While the human cost is clear, the Iranian regime has not just survived the war, it has been empowered.

items.title: Parents of Serbia's teenage school shooter given jail terms in retrial
items.description: The boy was 13 when he killed eight girls, a boy and a school guard at Vladislav Ribnikar school in Belgrade in 2023.

items.title: Hegseth renews Nato criticism and says US will review presence in Europe
items.description: The US defence secretary's move follows a US decision to scale back its commitments to a high readiness force within the alliance.
